name: Return to Primal Torntusk
summary: Elder Torntusk is free and sends you to Revantusk Village with word for his mate, Primal Torntusk.

sections.title: News for His Mate
sections.body: Elder Torntusk is free of his bindings and asks you to return to Revantusk Village. Tell his mate, Primal Torntusk, that he is coming home.

sections.title: The Village Is Grateful
sections.body: Primal Torntusk thanks you for serving the Revantusk. The village owes you a deep debt of gratitude.

faq.q: Who sends you on this journey?
aliases: who starts return to primal torntusk
faq.answer: Elder Torntusk sends you to carry news of his rescue to his mate.

aliases: where to turn in return to primal torntusk
faq.answer: Primal Torntusk is at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What am I supposed to tell Primal Torntusk?
faq.answer: Tell Primal Torntusk that Elder Torntusk is coming home.
This follows Recover the Key!, after the earlier effort that began in Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!.
